file_id: Vishnu S-O Shri Badri Prasad B-C Vaishy vs State Of Rajasthan Through Pp on 4 January, 2019

sentences.text: Vishnu S/O Shri Badri Prasad B/C Vaishy vs State Of Rajasthan

Through Pp on 4 January, 2019
 High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan
 Bench At Jaipur
 S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous (Petition) No. 7913/2018
Vishnu S/o Shri Badri Prasad B/c Vaishy
 ----Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Rajasthan Through Pp
 ----Respondent
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Dinesh Kumar Garg

entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan
 Bench At Jaipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
For Respondent(s) : Mr. N.S. Dhakad, Pp Hon'Ble Mr.
Justice Kanwaljit Singh Ahluwalia Order 04/01/2019
Counsel for the petitioner has submitted that it is wrongly alleged in the FIR that petitioner was selling synthetic milk.
Counsel for the petitioner has drawn attention of this court to Annx.2 report submitted by Food Safety and Standard Laboratory, Alwar(Raj.).

entities.text: Food Safety and Standard Laboratory, Alwar(Raj.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: As per the report, the sample seized was not of mixed milk but it was conforming the standards of skimmed milk.

Counsel for the petitioner has contended that in view of report of Forensic Science Laboratory,
petitioner can only be prosecuted for violations of provisions of Food Safety and Standard Act,
2006.
No offence is made out under the provisions of Indian Penal Code.
Issue notice to the respondents for 25.02.2019.
[CRLMP-7913/2018] Meanwhile, further proceedings arising out of impugned FIR shall remain stayed.

(KANWALJIT SINGH AHLUWALIA),J Heena/73 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
